policy.hit_probability: Up to 5 priced player-games ranked by calibrated hit probability; price does not affect rank.
policy.positive_ev: Up to 5 priced player-games ranked by expected ROI after edge ratio ≥ 1.25 and expected ROI ≥ 10%.
policy.pricing: Each 08:17, 11:17, and 17:17 ET checkpoint is evaluated separately at its best available book quote.
policy.timing_guard: A prediction must exist by the checkpoint, and picks whose games already started are excluded.
policy.stake: One unit per settled pick; American-odds profit on wins and -1 unit on losses.
policy.warning: Triples are rare and the live out-of-sample archive remains provisional. Model-estimated edge is not a guarantee of profit.
